import json
from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location, module_from_spec
import hashlib
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import jax
import levanter
import haliax
import marin
import iris
import fray
import zephyr
from iris.runtime.telemetry import resolve
import pytest

class Journal:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = Path(path)
    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session):
        self.path.with_suffix('.collection.json').write_text(json.dumps([item.nodeid for item in session.items], indent=2) + '\n')
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        with self.path.open('a') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps({'nodeid': report.nodeid, 'when': report.when, 'outcome': report.outcome, 'duration': report.duration}) + '\n')
            stream.flush()

def main():
    expected = int(sys.argv[1])
    spec = spec_from_file_location("native_fp8_training_final_pin", "artifact:native-fp8-ema-pin.py")
    pin = module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(pin)
    print(json.dumps({"runtime_source_pin_before": pin.validate()}), flush=True)
    assert "JAX_NUM_CPU_DEVICES" not in os.environ
    assert jax.device_count() == expected
    assert all(device.platform == 'cpu' for device in jax.devices())
    assert resolve() is None
    root = str(Path.cwd())
    modules = {module.__name__: module.__file__ for module in (levanter, haliax, marin, iris, fray, zephyr)}
    assert all(root in path for path in modules.values()), modules
    print(json.dumps({'actual_devices': jax.device_count(), 'python': sys.executable, 'source_modules': modules, 'iris_publishing_runtime': False, 'main_guard_for_multiprocessing': True}), flush=True)
    status = pytest.main(sys.argv[3:], plugins=[Journal(sys.argv[2])])
    print(json.dumps({"runtime_source_pin_after": pin.validate()}), flush=True)
    return status

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
